[[Scorpion]]s can be assigned as a [[slayer task]] at level 7 [[Combat level|combat]] by various low end [[Slayer masters]] and are generally meant as tasks for beginners. Scorpions attack with [[melee]] and a few certain varieties are capable of [[poison]]ing. Interestingly various fightable [[lobster]]s also counts as scorpions.
Scorpions have very limited drop tables, usually only dropping [[ensouled scorpion head]]s and [[clue scroll (beginner)|beginner clue scrolls]].

Players can also kill [[Scorpia]] as part of a scorpion task; however, she is located in extremely deep (50+) Wilderness in a [[multicombat area]], and freezes are required in order to kill the boss efficiently. It is a very popular player killing spot, so players should not bring items they are unwilling to lose.
